notes.title: Steam Cloud fix for macOS : keep your local files !
notes.content:
[p]Hello,

I just fixed the Steam Cloud for macOS. So if you're on macOS, Steam should ask you if you want to use the Cloud save files or to keep your local files : choose to keep the local files, or else you're going to lose all your saved games.

[h2]before you launch the game, it's strongly recommended to back up your saved games ![/h2]

In case this choice isn't displayed, before you launch the game, it's strongly recommended to back up this folder :  ~/Library/Application Support/Mana Games/Tennis Elbow 4/Profiles . So if everything is deleted, you'll just have to reinstall your Mods, reselect your profile if you have created one and restore that folder.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

[h2]If you have lost your files[/h2]

Check with Time Machine if you have activated it ; maybe they are there, although it's really uncertain.

The folder you'd need to restore is the same as above : ~/Library/Application Support/Mana Games/Tennis Elbow 4/Profiles .

notes.title: Version 1.0 !
notes.content:
Hello,

after nearly 6 years of development, we finally reached the version 1.0 of Tennis Elbow 4 ! ːsteamhappyː

It's still not the end of the road and I'll still improve the game, but once I'm done with the new movement animations (either it's a success or a failure :fear: ), I won't work full time on TE4 anymore.

And here's the full changelog for the version 1.0 - Build 137 ; SubBuild 2025.3.4:

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Animation : experimental new movement animations ! I used the animation set bundled with the Motion Matching plug-in I bought, which direly misses sidesteps and small footwork ; you can activate it in Settings -> 3D Match (Give your impressions => https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic7-36310.php ) ; note : this system requires some extra memory and will lead to crash on consoles if you have Mods installed (especially when playing doubles)
- Settings : added a Tennis.ini editor ; click on the little white icon on the bottom right of Settings -> Misc Options to access it
- World Tour : rankings updated to 2024, and new players added if you start a new career (if you have a Mod for the World Tour, you won't see these additions)
- Localization : Japanese translation, thanks to Tam ! (please report any typo)

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Strike : halved the loss of power when getting tired, which should shorten rallies by making it easier to hit winners when both players are tired
- Strike : boosted the short strike speed by up to 4km/h, to help doing passing shots with it (it was too curvy and slow before, allowing too many easy volleys)
- Service : raised the Aiming Zone on Service Preview so the ball should almost never land outside of it
- AI : lowered the jump at the net of the CPU for the Club-10 and Junior-10 so their rally & net performances are more balanced (this will have some diminished effect till Pro-9)
- Physics : now, hitting the ball with the frame of the racket will make the normal & long strikes end too long instead of in the net

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : the player could bend too harshly in some situations (usually when sliding)
- Animation : animation loading was randomly failing, leading to a crash (and online desyncs) ; tried a fix, but I'm not 100% sure it'll work in all cases (it's a Unity bug :fear: )
- 3D Match : after having played for a while (ie: more than 30 minutes), the hair, hat, and possibly the eyes were moved over the head
- Physics : some topspin balls had a too low chance to end in the net
- Commentary : fixed a few lines played in the wrong situation
- World Tour & Camera : (consoles only) since the last update, it was not possible to export your player to the Training Club nor save a Camera in Settings -> Camera
- World Tour : the Experience points were capped at 200 when starting a 3D match
- Modding : modifying the RankPerYear in the Player bases wasn't seen right away in your saved career

[code][Camera]

AutoU1        =    0.3323

AutoV2        =    0.7810[/code]
ie: no more manual positioning of the camera, you just note down where are the top left & bottom right corners of the lines ! notes.title: Tennis Elbow 4 - Version 0.46 - Build 60
notes.content:
Finally, the outfit modding is coming !

With it, most of the game is now moddable, although some things will change in the future to be easier to Mod (mostly the sounds, and the 2D court organization).

You'll still have to wait tomorrow (or Thursday) to get your hands on the TE4 Modding SDK that will allow you to Mod the outfit.

And here the changelog for this new version :

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Outfit : separated the left & right wristbands, so they can be tuned independently
- Outift : separated the mesh selection from the texture selection for the hats, so it'll be easier to add modded textures for each hat
- Modding : the engine can load outfit images (wait for the Modding SDK to use that functionality)
- Modding : the CPU players in the World Tour without an outfit code can now use the modded animations as well as the modded outfits

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- AI : raised by ~50% the efficiency of the Self Confidence, so if a CPU player plays vs himself, except he has 100% in Self Confidence and the other one has 0%, then he'll win nearly 60% of the sets
- Animation : slightly lowered the reach of the 2-handed forehand while on the run and significantly lower the reach on both sides, for all animations, when running back to the baseline ; all this is to prevent too weird stretching from the dynamic animation system

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Gameplay : the Surface skills, although hidden from the GUI, were still active during the game
- Animation : since the last Build, the CPU could sidestep all the way back from the net to the baseline when he had to do a smash there ; now, he'll just run back normally
- Animation : fixed a few cases where the human-controller player could wrongly predict when he was going to hit the ball, leading to strange things in the dynamic animation system, as well as gliding & animation jerking
- Animation : the human-controller player could hit clip the ball (and do a fault) instead of waiting for a tiny bit more to hit it back into play (when the ball was going to the player on left/right instead of going away from him)
- Animation : when running back to the baseline, the ball height could be wrongly predicted, leading the dynamic animation system to compress the player into the ground ':D
- Helpers : the Danger Zone wasn't displayed if the ball was going extremely high (ie: ~15 meters or more)

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
- The TE4 Modding SDK should come tomorrow (or else it'll be on Thursday :fear: )
- Your current outfit in your saved Career may be partially changed ; you can re-tune it by clicking on your 3D player in the Character Sheet

notes.title: Tennis Elbow 4 - Version 0.45
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.45[/h1]

Here's the full support for the controllers with dedicated icons and a better default configuration for the XBox & Playstation controllers, as well as an easier menu navigation ; I hope it works well, but if you notice anything wrong, don't hesitate to let me know..! :-)

[h2]New Features :[/h2]
- Controls : added icons to clearly represent the different axis and buttons of the XBox & Playstation controller, as well as a new default configuration for this type of controllers
- Controls : switched to Rewired plugin[i] (1)[/i], which should better handle controllers in a general way, especially exotic ones[i] (2)[/i]
- Controls : up/down and left/right are now correctly handled, so the menu navigation with a controller should be much easier than before[i] (3)[/i]
- Controls : you should be able now to plug-in & remove your controller while the game is running

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- World Tour : Taiwan has been renamed to Chinese Tapei, as by sport competition standards

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- World Tour : age of your player could be incorrect on the Week 52
- World Tour : Indoor streaks were counting as Synthethic or Hard
- World Tour : fixed a crash when starting a career with 4 players in season mode
- Animation : on MacOs Big Sur, the players could get their knees up in the air

[h2]Notes :[/h2]
(1) - if you're on Mac or if you were using the triggers, this will change your current controls, so don't forget to check them in the Controls menu
(2) - please let me know if your controller still doesn't work correctly with this version
(3) - if you see some weird stuff happening when navigating the menus with a controller, please let me know

notes.title: Version 0.44

- Modding : can change the number of talent stars when starting a new game with the NbStar entry under [WT_NewGame] in your Tennis.ini

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
- Gameplay : now when the Short Term form lowers, it'll also make the max energy lower till ~90%, even before reaching the threshold
- Gameplay : it's a bit less penalizing to hit the volley off-centered, so the extra-reach is more useful and let you do more decent shots
- Gameplay : it's not possible to have net balls on the 2nd serve for the human players, as there was a light risk to double fault because of it
- AI : the CPU predicts now better the chance a ball can go too wild, and thus do a bit less stupid faults (especially when his Tactic skill is high)
- AI : the CPU now doesn't use the Short Acceleration anymore if it has too much chance to not be short enough (especially when his Tactic skill is high)
- Talent : the Slice Mastery talent slightly raises the slice precision, so it's more efficient when prepared a bit late
- Control : autopos now makes your player go backward if you try to smash a high ball after it has bounced
- Online : the game now automatically auto-repings the hosts that didn't answer (ie: with red infinite pings)

[h2]Bug Fixes :[/h2]
- Animation : fixed a frozen animation when trying to smash a ball too high to be hit
- Animation : fixed a couple of animation issues when the CPU player was late to play a smash
- AI : when running backward, the CPU could hit the ball before the bounce while he had decided to actually hit it after the bounce
- HUD : the indicated stress from playing against a lower-ranked player was much bigger than what it really was

notes.title: Tennis Elbow 4 released on Steam Early Access
notes.content:
Tennnis Elbow 4, the long-awaited sequel to Tennis Elbow 2013, is now released in Early Access on Steam on June 4th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7998887/1b7b393d455850a53c6fd93b4afaff05c31be03b.png[/img]

It has been already available from managames.com for almost 2 years now, and the game is already more complete than TE2013, except its Modding support is still limited.

TE4 current main improvements over TE2013 are :
- Improved visuals, including new players, 9 stadiums and 9 more coming
- Reworked physics so everything is more realistic ; as a main example : now if you hit a ball when mispositioned and/or too late, it'll always have a chance  to end in the net or go wild
- Redesigned menus
- Dynamic animation so the players always put their racket on the ball (it still needs tuning to look ok in all situations)
- Men Tour starts in 1973 & Women Tour in 1983
- Junior Tour
- Future fictional years are generated in real-time, so each playthrough sees different top players in the future
- Olympiads

https://store.steampowered.com/app/760640/Tennis_Elbow_4/

The future main area of improvements will be the animations, but it'll have also new content : mainly new stadiums & a single tournament mode.

It should also soon have a new input configuration system, much easier for controllers, with presets already done for XBox & PS4/5 controllers. (right no

You'll find the roadmap and more info here : https://www.managames.com/Forum/topic15-33253.php .

I hope you'll enjoy all this and if you have any feedback, you're welcome here : https://steamcommunity.com/app/760640/discussions/ ; and there : https://www.managames.com/Forum/ .
